notes.title: Major Update 2.1.0.0
notes.content:
MAIN ADDITIONS

- 15 more new shots
- 7 more new enemies
- 1 more new boss
- 1 more new Starship
- 1 more new Special Starship
- 5 more new adventure mode stages
- 1 more new meteor
- 1 more new crystal type

Added new in-game Achievements system including a scene to view progress and achieved achievements.

Equipment:
Added in-game Equipment system.
Equipment will be a new type of passive upgrade for Starships, which can be purchased and equipped in the shop.
- Added 6 new miscellaneous equipment.
 

INFINITE MODE
Improved some backgrounds in infinite mode.
Small balance in infinite mode.
Some other minor improvements to Endless Mode.

ADVENTURE MODE
Improved the feedback of the adventure mode buttons.
Improved the background of some adventure mode levels.
Some other minor improvements to adventure mode.

SURVIVAL MODE
Small balance in difficulty of survival mode.

SHOP
Visual improvement in the store.
Best Feedback from the store.
Small tweaks in the Store.


BALANCE
- Nerf on the shot that follows the player.
- Nerf on some enemy shots.
- Buff on the player's crystal gain.

OTHER IMPROVEMENTS
- Change system of achievements sent to Steam.
- Minor in-game optimization.
- Minor bug fixes.
- Visual improvement on some shots.

notes.title: Great Update 2.0.0.0
notes.content:
Great Update of 05/31/22

A new update bringing another game mode and several other news!!

Update Details and News

What's new


+ 1 New Game Mode (Survival Mode)
+ 7 New Enemies
+ 16 New Shots
+ 5 New Phases of Adventure Mode
+ 3 New Spaceships
+ 1 New Godfather
+ 2 New Special Shots
+ 4 New Steam Achievements


Improvements and Adjustments


 Now the game has another challenging and fun game mode called "Survival Mode".
 Adventure Mode is now divided into 6 galaxies with 5 phases each galaxy.
 Adjustments to the difficulty of Infinite Mode and Adventure Mode.
 Several visual improvements.
 Minor bug fixes.
 Improvements to the user experience.
 Added a screen to contextualize the story of the game.
 Small settings in the game store.
 More than 20 enemies have been adjusted for Survival Mode.
 Several other minor improvements.


Follow Starship Wars!!
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/igolitoarts/

notes.title: Details of the February 1, 2022 update.
notes.content:
Update 1.0.0.8

Changes

1 - Now the mouse cursor is invisible during gameplay.

2 - Now the particles are above the enemies.

3 - It is now easier to identify when an enemy takes damage.

4 - Correction in the price of some items in the store.

5 - Some minor improvements.

Good game!!

notes.title: Details of the January 26, 2022 update.
notes.content:
Update 1.0.0.7

Changes

1 - Now the amount of damage taken when the player receives damage now appears.

2 - Now enemy shots collide with the asteroids.

3 - Corrections in the price of some items in the store.

4 - Corrections in the amount of crystals earned in some levels of adventure mode.

5 - Minor graphical corrections.

Good game!!
